title: Sign in to the outgoing Trader Support Service (TSS)
text:
Changes to the Trader Support Service

 The new Trader Support Service has launched. It can support you with the customs arrangements for goods moving to or from Northern Ireland.

 All new movements must now be submitted using the new service.

 If you were already signed up for the outgoing Trader Support Service, you’ll have been migrated to the new service and will not need to register again. If you have declarations in progress that were submitted using the old Trader Support Service you’ll be able to continue managing these declarations through to completion.

 If you’re not already signed up, you can now  register for the new service to declare goods that you’re moving to or from Northern Ireland .

 From 30 November the old Trader Support Service will close, and all users will be expected to use the new Trader Support Service (TSS) .

 If you have any questions, you can call the Trader Support Service team on 0800 870 8173 between 7am and 10pm, 7 days a week.

 You can use this service to manage goods movements and add users to your account. This service will remain available until 30 November 2026.

 Sign in
changeNote: Information has been updated to confirm that from 20 October 2026 all new movements must be made using the new Trader Support Service. Existing movements that began before 20 October 2026 can continue to be managed through the outgoing Trader Support Service.
